title: Centreville

services.name: Tickets
services.desc: Rides have height restrictions in place for safety reasons. Young children may need to be accompanied by a rider over 4 feet tall. Babies and infants who cannot support themselves are not permitted on rides. There is no entrance fee, you only need to purchase tickets or passes if you are going on rides. Online Purchases: Tickets must be purchased at least one day before your visit. Save when you buy online! 🎡 No Entrance Fee! Enjoy the park for free and only pay for rides with a Day Pass for unlimited fun all day, a Season Pass for unlimited rides all season, or a Family Pass for a budget-friendly way to enjoy the park

services.name: Party package
services.desc: Located only minutes away from downtown, the Toronto Islands provide a unique opportunity for you and your co-workers to enjoy one of a kind group event while escaping the hustle of the city life. Ensure your employees feel valued and rewarded by choosing from a wide array of special team-building and networking
